about: Package 9, motion: the tier change as one View Transition (shell/tier.ts), the desk's own transition (features/motion.ts: tiles and pedals arriving, leaving and moving, the landing after a drop, the cables drawing out), the blocks that push what follows (features/motion-blocks.ts) and the small motions on a change of state (features/motion-kicks.ts), with reduced motion as the concept designs it. The scenarios of scenarios/38-motion.mjs sample positions and animations over time; most hold on the concept page too.

scenarios.why: The tier change as one object per part (Q-13): a View Transition in which the page does not cross-fade, the tier switch takes no part, a tile's header does not fade, a tile's old and new faces are never shown together, the prompt card's words do not fade, and nothing is left named after it. (Waited on package 9 in fix-core.json.)
The tile under the pointer keeps its top edge through each tier change (Q-14): the anchor takes the pointer's tile. (Waited on package 9 in fix-core.json.)
S-27: under reduced motion a tile that arrives carries the still ring. (Excluded in fix-core.json as motion's.)

The tier change read at 0, 32 ... 270ms: Tempo's frame starts on the tile's old box, grows step by step and ends on its new one; its old face is gone by 60ms and the new one never shows before; its header never fades; nothing is left named after.
A tile added starts unseen at .96 scale; what it pushed starts where it stood and ends where it stands.
A tile removed is shown where it stood and fades; its neighbours close up from where they stood; nothing of it is left after; Undo brings it back by its entrance to its place, focus on its grip.
A tile moved by an arrow key starts where it stood and slides through the places between. (The concept's tile moved up jumps up at once, then slides sideways: this check does not hold there.)
A dropped tile starts on its preview's box, 2% larger, and settles into the same box (M-13, Q-15; deviation 39 closed).
A pedal that joins starts unseen 10px above where it lands, the new cables draw out of their jacks and follow it, and it is rung once it has landed.
Under reduced motion a tile arrives and leaves by fading only, is rung with the still outline (S-27), and the tier changes with no transition.
A tile whose content grows (the lyric sheet typed into) re-packs the desk with the tiles it moves sliding over --t-base.
Undo shrinking the prompt box, a suggestion opening and closing, Song info opening: what follows starts where it stood and moves (deviation 52 closed).
An LED switch turned on kicks (a redraw does not), a stamp chosen thunks, a folded side panel fades its rail in, Generate's label cross-fades.
Show in Lab rings the module it reveals; a tile added below the fold is brought into view.
After 12 seconds with nothing happening the page is calm (its loops rest); a key wakes it.
The player joining the go bar moves the line beside it over from where it stood (compositor only).

Quick's fold (merged from ui-next 43be87c2) moves as every change of which tiles show: opened, a tile it shows arrives by its entrance and what it moves starts where it stood; folded again, a tile it hides fades where it stood, and nothing is left. (The concept's fading tile stands 92px off where it stood at 1600, its exit layer's padding: that check does not hold there, P9-7.)
